title: Cycle Detection in undirected Graph (dfs)
intuition: Undirected: DFS with parent skip; or BFS parent; or DSU while adding edges.

approaches.title: DFS + parent
approaches.idea: Visit neighbor already seen and not parent → cycle.

approaches.title: DSU while inserting edges
approaches.idea: Union fails ⇒ edge connects same component ⇒ cycle.

commonMistakes: Using undirected algorithm on directed graphs
patternRecognition: “Detect cycle” → pick directed vs undirected first
followUps: Earliest edge that creates a cycle
interviewInsight: Clarify directed vs undirected in sentence one — prevents a full rewrite.
